"""Poll pure browser reads across navigation; never replay actions or inputs."""
import asyncio
import time

import pytest

from pa.browser.cdp import CdpError

_now = time.monotonic


async def wait_for_read_condition(page, expression):
    """Only for side-effect-free predicates in these disposable browser tests."""
    deadline = _now() + 15
    navigation_errors = 0
    while _now() < deadline:
        try:
            if await page.evaluate(expression):
                return
        except CdpError as exc:
            # The old document can disappear between a click and this read.
            # A permanently closed target still fails at the same deadline;
            # unrelated CDP/JS errors and cancellation propagate immediately.
            if str(exc) != "Inspected target navigated or closed":
                raise
            navigation_errors += 1
        await asyncio.sleep(.05)
    pytest.fail(
        "Browser condition did not become true: " + expression
        + f" (navigation-context errors: {navigation_errors})"
    )

    page = Mock(evaluate=AsyncMock(side_effect=[

    with patch('tests.browser_conditions.asyncio.sleep', new_callable=AsyncMock) as sleep:
        await wait_for_read_condition(page, "location.pathname === '/login'")
    assert page.evaluate.await_count == 3
    assert all(call.args == ("location.pathname === '/login'",) for call in page.evaluate.await_args_list)

    # Start at100, one failed read at100, and no read once the115deadline arrives.

        with pytest.raises(pytest.fail.Exception, match='navigation-context errors: 1'):
